meta.title: Session scheduling
meta.description: Lets an agent drive other conversations: sessions_create opens a session in any project directory; sessions_send delivers a message to a running or stopped session (mode=queue waits for the current turn, mode=steer interrupts and injects it); sessions_stop cancels the turn that is running; sessions_archive and sessions_unarchive hide or restore a session; sessions_wait blocks until a session finishes a turn or asks for input and returns its last reply; sessions_list reads visible sessions with live status (running, idle, waiting for approval, queued messages) and resolves a title or id prefix. Session content and logs stay with DSH; the plugin copies nothing. Limitations: an archived session no longer appears in sessions_list, so it can only be restored by full id; sessions_stop keeps queued messages unless dropQueue is set; a target session cannot see the calling session's context, so messages must be self-contained. Disabling the plugin removes these tools; delivered messages and archived state stay as they are.

tool.list: List visible sessions with live status
tool.create: Open a session in a project directory
tool.send: Message a running or stopped session
tool.stop: Stop the running turn of a session
tool.wait: Wait for a session to finish and return its reply
